title: Golf Advent Calendar – 24 Golf Accessories
seo_description: A Christmas gift he'll actually use on the course, not the next gift idea on a list.
descriptionHtml:
The golf bag empties itself quietly

Tees snap, balls disappear in the rough or the water, the brush falls out of the side pocket — and nobody puts it on a wish list, because it feels too small to ask for. So the gift ends up being either a club he already has, or a gift card that lands in a drawer until spring.

24 doors, already filled with what he keeps running out of

Instead of chocolate, this calendar has golf accessories behind every door: golf balls, plastic and wooden tees, ball markers, a green repair tool with a mirror, a club cleaning brush and a golf towel, among other things. He opens one door a day until Christmas Eve — and what's in there is the kind of thing that actually ends up in the bag, not in a drawer with the gift wrap still on.

Here's what you get

  • A gift he'll actually use on the course – not the next gift idea on a list.
  • 24 days of countdown to Christmas – not a bag of candy eaten in ten minutes.
  • Tops up what he keeps buying himself anyway – before he has time to miss it.
  • One package to wrap – not 24 separate small gifts to keep track of.
  • 24 numbered doors, pre-filled with golf accessories — nothing to fill yourself.
  • The contents are golf accessories in plastic, metal and wood: among other things golf balls, tees, ball marker pens, alignment markers, a cap clip with ball marker, a green repair tool with a mirror, a T-wrench for shoe spikes, a club cleaning brush, a groove tool, key rings and a golf towel with a clip.
  • Carton: 30 × 28 × 6 cm, approx. 500 g — can be sent directly as a gift.
  • Aimed at adults and teenagers who play golf. The manufacturer states neither a CE mark nor an age limit, so it is never described as child-safe.

Frequently asked questions

What is behind the doors?
Golf accessories in plastic, metal and wood — among other things golf balls, tees, ball marker pens, alignment markers, a green repair tool with a mirror, a club cleaning brush and a golf towel. The manufacturer doesn't specify exactly what is behind each individual door, so we can't list it door by door.

Is the calendar pre-filled, or do I fill it myself?
Pre-filled. All 24 doors have contents already when the calendar arrives — nothing to buy and fill in yourself.

Is it suitable for children?
It's made for adults and teenagers who play golf, not for younger children. The contents have small loose parts such as tees and markers, and the manufacturer states neither a CE mark nor an age limit — so we never describe it as child-safe.

How big is the carton, and can it be sent directly as a gift?
30 × 28 × 6 cm and weighs approx. 500 g. It's easy to mail directly to the recipient.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
